ROOT-1 (wiring): `load_model` never threads the resolved active substrate or manifest stamps into the weight-file choice, so the stamp-gated `admit_quant_variant` cannot be interposed — the "admit only behind a passing accuracy stamp" invariant is asserted in docs/tests but not enforced in the live path; and the graph-driven dtype seam was only retrofitted onto the 2 arms that hit the crash, not universalized. ROOT-2 (the alias myth): "q4f16-on-CUDA is BLOCKED by the ort IoBinding same-run past==present alias" conflates CORRECTNESS with a PERF layer. The exact-length two-buffer ping-pong (in_place_static=false, ort/src/lib.rs:243 growing/symbolic export, Phase-2/3 proven byte-identical) already runs F16 KV correctly on CUDA (Phase-5 device-KV F16 cell shipped, task #88). The alias is needed ONLY for the realloc-free in-place buffer + the CUDA-graph fixed-ADDRESS precondition (ep.rs:245-253) — i.e. an ADDITIVE perf win, not a correctness gate. So q4f16-on-CUDA correctness is not actually blocked; the fused-graph throughput layer is.

designs.name: D-A: Wire the stamp-gated admission into load_model + universalize the graph-driven dtype seam (the foundational fix)
designs.mechanism: (1) Thread the substrate + stamps into loading: add a manifest `quant_stamps` array parsed in Manifest::from_json (model.rs:60) into `Vec<QuantStamp>` (stamp = {precision, ep, passed} already at model.rs:253 — just add serde reader; today unread). Change `load_model(dir, loader)` (model.rs:642) to resolve the active EP FIRST (loader exposes it — OrtModel::active_ep, ort/lib.rs:725) or accept an `EpCaps` arg from the caller (engine.rs already knows the resolved EP), then for EACH graph call `admit_quant_variant(graph_precision_token(logical), &caps, &stamps)` (model.rs:357) BEFORE `weight_path` (model.rs:211). On a `reference` verdict (unstamped/failed quant) rewrite the effective suffix to fp32 and emit the `reasons` telemetry (quant_unstamped/quant_stamp_failed) — a graceful DEGRADE, replacing today's hard int8-on-CUDA reject at ep.rs:184 with the designed fallback. (2) Universalize the dtype seam: replace every hardcoded-f32 empty-state builder in the AR/enc-dec arms (parakeet.rs, whisper.rs decoder KV, moonshine.rs, cohere.rs, canary.rs) with `empty_kv_dtype_for`/`feed_float` (runtime/precision.rs:45,82) exactly as voxtral.rs:31 does — feature inputs stay f32 by NAME (F32_FEATURE_INPUTS, precision.rs:26), KV follows the graph. Now a `_q4f16`/`_fp16` manifest swap is zero-code on ALL Path-A arms.
designs.projected_win: Universalizes safe quant to every ONNX arch with zero per-model code. Roofline: on memory-bound Path-A graphs (whisper/parakeet encoders, dense decode) fp16→q4f16 cuts weight bytes ~3.9× → step-time floor ~3.9× lower in the memory-bound regime (perf_equations.decode_step_bytes; 2B example 20.2→5.2ms). Footprint: 4× resident weight reduction on the 130GB unified pool → ~4× model/slot admission headroom (the aggregate-throughput lever). Safety win is unbounded: closes the hole where an unproven int8/q4 manifest silently ships today.
designs.tdd_plan: RED FIRST: (t1) `load_model_degrades_unstamped_quant_to_fp32` — a NopLoader manifest with precision:int8 + empty stamps must load fp32 + reason quant_unstamped (fails today: no gate wired). (t2) `load_model_admits_stamped_quant` — same manifest + QuantStamp::pass(int8,Cuda) loads int8. (t3) per-arm `parakeet_empty_state_dtype_follows_graph` — a fake graph declaring F16 KV yields F16 empty state (fails today: hardcoded f32). ACCURACY GATE: byte-identical for the fp32/dtype-seam path (the fp32 arm produces bit-identical tensors — deterministic, host_vs_graph oracle); for an ADMITTED lossy quant the gate is the OFFLINE ASR-WER (STT) / MOS (TTS) stamp authored by eval/ harnesses, NOT byte-identical. PERF GATE: q4f16 whisper-encoder achieved-bandwidth MBU within 15% of the 3.9×-lower memory floor (perf_equations.mbu).
designs.coverage: UNIVERSAL across Path-A/ORT: all STT (whisper/moonshine/parakeet/cohere/canary/sensevoice enc-dec + AR) and ORT TTS. Quant tiers fp32/fp16/q4f16/int8(CPU). Scoped-out: Path-B/tch arms have no input_types() (default empty, backend-api:539) so the dtype seam is ORT-only — Path-B precision is D-C's job. Hardware: any EP (gate is pure logic over EpCaps).
designs.risks_conflicts: Byte-identity law: the fp32/dtype-seam path stays byte-identical (same arm, same tensors) — SAFE; the lossy admit path is the explicit WER/MOS-gated relaxation the invariants permit. Ring-KV: untouched (only empty-state dtype changes). CONFLICT: `admit_quant_variant` is CPU-blind (model.rs:366 ActiveEp::Cpu→None) so an int8-on-CPU stamp can NEVER match though int8-on-CPU is explicitly valid (EpKind::forbids_int8_gemm scopes to CUDA/TRT only) — must extend QuantStamp to carry a Cpu variant. DESIGN-VS-WIRED: this IS the wiring fix — it makes the tested-but-dead gate live in load_model.

designs.name: D-B: Ship q4f16-on-CUDA as the default CUDA quant via exact-length ping-pong buffers (decouple correctness from the IoBinding alias)
designs.mechanism: Reframe the 'blocker': the exact-length two-buffer ping-pong (in_place_static=false, ort/lib.rs:243) already runs F16 KV byte-identically on CUDA (Phase-2/3 proven, Phase-5 F16 cell shipped). So make q4f16 the DEFAULT admitted CUDA quant for arches with a passing CUDA WER stamp, riding the ALREADY-CORRECT ping-pong path — NOT waiting on the ort-fork. Mechanism: (1) manifest declares by_substrate[cuda]=q4f16 + a passing CUDA stamp; D-A's gate admits it; the graph-driven dtype seam (empty_kv_dtype_for) sizes the F16 empty KV; run_bound/two-buffer ping-pong executes it. (2) Keep the in-place `past==present` alias + fused CUDA-graph as an OPTIONAL additive perf layer (ep.rs:245-253) behind a WAAV flag, honestly labeled 'not-yet' — its win (realloc-free + fixed-address graph capture) is measured to straddle the per-slot 2.34×@B24 in GB10 noise (ep.rs:250), so it is NOT on the critical path for the memory/footprint win. Portable path around the blocker = exact-length buffers, exactly as the gap statement's option (a).
designs.projected_win: Unblocks q4f16-on-CUDA TODAY (no ort-fork): 3.9× weight-byte cut on the memory-bound weight-read + 4× residency on the unified pool. For the ORT dense encoder graphs (whisper/voxtral audio encoder — genuinely memory/compute-bound, not launch-bound) this is a real per-step win; for launch-bound Path-B it is footprint/admission only (honest). Basis: perf_equations decode_step_bytes weight term flat-in-B, 3.9× fewer bytes.
designs.tdd_plan: RED FIRST: (t1) `q4f16_cuda_pingpong_bit_identical_to_host_run` — device-KV F16 ping-pong output == host fp32-widened reference within the F16-declared-graph oracle (extends host_vs_device_kv_oracle). (t2) `q4f16_default_admitted_on_cuda_with_stamp` (rides D-A gate). ACCURACY GATE: q4f16 is lossy vs fp32 → gate is CUDA ASR-WER (STT: |WER−fp32|<0.02, matching the dia2 bf16 0.0129-vs-0.0337 equivalence bar) / MOS (TTS); the ping-pong path itself is byte-identical to the SAME-precision host loop (deterministic). PERF GATE: q4f16 resident weight bytes = 0.26× fp16 (measured via load-time byte counter); step MBU vs the 3.9× floor.
designs.coverage: CUDA Path-A AR/enc-dec that ship a q4f16 export (voxtral proven; chatterbox language_model; whisper/parakeet where onnx-community q4f16 exists). Tiers: q4f16 primary, fp16 fallback. Scoped: the in-place-alias fused-graph perf layer stays deferred (documented, flag-gated) — NOT a correctness dependency. Hardware: CUDA (the ping-pong + F16 KV path); CPU keeps int8.
designs.risks_conflicts: Byte-identity: q4f16 is a lossy fork → MUST land only behind D-A's WER/MOS stamp, never silent. cfg_batch (cfg_batch.rs:177 CfgBatchRefusal): q4f16 is orthogonal to the batch-2 CFG reduction refusal (that's a TF32 reassociation issue) — no interaction at B=1 ping-pong; a future q4f16+batched-flow path must re-check. Ring-KV: F16 empty-tensor dtype must be graph-driven (D-A) or the F16 CUDA node rejects an f32 seed. DESIGN-VS-WIRED: wires into the live serve path via the existing run_bound/device-KV loop — no new dead machinery; the alias/graph layer is explicitly parked, not faked.

designs.name: D-C: Unify Path-B native-precision under the SAME stamp abstraction (auto fast-kernel load on a passing WER stamp)
designs.mechanism: Path-B (tch) has PrecisionMode::resolve (nn/precision.rs:68) gated on WAAV_<M>_PRECISION but its DEFAULT is manual (Sandwich for dia2/s2_pro). Generalize D-A's stamp to also drive the tch native/sandwich fork: when the manifest carries a passing per-substrate WER/MOS stamp for a native-precision token (bf16/fp16), auto-select PrecisionMode::Native (flip the golden default) and auto-load the native-cast weights (the ~10-line recipe already in nn/precision.rs:29-39: cast hot weights to compute dtype, feed ProjPrec::Native to shared Attention). One `QuantStamp`-like `PrecisionStamp` reader serves BOTH the ONNX quant gate (D-A) and the tch native fork — a single admission abstraction across Path-A and Path-B. Telemetry honest via PrecisionMode::label (nn/precision.rs:103, 'bf16-native' vs 'f32-sandwich').
designs.projected_win: dia2 native-bf16 MEASURED 1.25× backbone GEMM at WER-equivalent (0.0129 vs 0.0337) — auto-on when stamped instead of manual env. Extends the fast-kernel default to the whole codec-AR fleet uniformly. Basis: measured dia2; the other codec-AR models already default Native so this mainly flips dia2/s2_pro + makes the choice declarative+audited rather than an operator env.
designs.tdd_plan: RED FIRST: (t1) `native_precision_auto_on_with_passing_wer_stamp` — dia2 manifest + PrecisionStamp::pass(bf16,Cuda) resolves Native without any env (fails today: default is Sandwich). (t2) `native_precision_stays_sandwich_unstamped` — no stamp ⇒ byte-identical Sandwich preserved (the golden). ACCURACY GATE: WER (dia2 |WER−f32|<0.02, the measured-equivalent bar) / MOS — NOT byte-identical (native is a legitimate different-valid AR realization, the two-tier accuracy law). PERF GATE: dia2 backbone GEMM ≥1.2× vs sandwich (measured 1.25×).
designs.coverage: Path-B/tch codec-AR fleet: dia2, s2_pro (sandwich-tax models — real speed win), + csm/qwen3/misotts/higgs/higgs_v2 (already Native; stamp makes it audited). Tiers: bf16/fp16 native vs f32-sandwich. Scoped: tch-only (ONNX quant is D-A/D-B); off-CUDA stays f32 (nn/precision.rs:70, native≡sandwich).
designs.risks_conflicts: Byte-identity: native IS a fork → the stamp is the explicit WER/MOS relaxation; the byte-identical sandwich MUST remain the unstamped default (never silent). cfg_batch batch-2 refusal: native bf16 + TF32 interplay — the existing WAAV_ORT_TF32=0/kTF32-unset discipline (ep.rs:220, cfg_batch.rs) must stay ON so a batched native forward doesn't reassociate; a native+batched-flow combo re-triggers the CfgBatchRefusal check. Lockstep/ring-KV: unaffected (precision-only). DESIGN-VS-WIRED: PrecisionMode is already live-wired per model; this only adds the stamp-driven auto-default — reuses the live path, adds no dead code.

dossiers.recommended: D-A is the keystone and must land first: without threading the active substrate + manifest stamps into load_model and universalizing the graph-driven dtype seam, the entire tested-but-dead quant-admission machinery (admit_quant_variant/resolve_precision/QuantStamp) stays inert and (c)/(d)/D-B/D-C have nothing to hang off. D-A converts the invariant 'admit only behind a passing accuracy stamp' from a doc claim into an enforced load-path gate and makes a zero-code `_q4f16`/`_fp16` manifest swap safe on every ORT arch. D-B then rides D-A to ship q4f16-on-CUDA immediately via the already-byte-identical exact-length ping-pong (correctly reframing the 'ort alias blocker' as a deferred perf layer, not a correctness gate — the single most important myth-correction in this gap). D-C unifies Path-B under the same stamp so precision is one declarative, audited abstraction across ONNX-quant and tch-native. Sequence: D-A → D-B → D-C, all sharing one PrecisionStamp reader.
dossiers.other_gaps_found: (1) admit_quant_variant is CPU-blind (model.rs:366): ActiveEp::Cpu→None means no stamp can ever admit int8-on-CPU, yet int8-on-CPU is explicitly the valid path (EpKind::forbids_int8_gemm scopes rejection to CUDA/TRT only, model.rs:600) — QuantStamp needs a Cpu-substrate variant or the CPU int8 quant path is unreachable through the gate. (2) The live int8-on-CUDA guard (ep.rs:184 BackendError::Precision) is a HARD ERROR at graph-load, but the designed admission is a graceful degrade-to-fp32 — a behavior mismatch: today an int8-CUDA manifest fails the load instead of falling back. D-A reconciles this by choosing fp32 BEFORE the ORT load. (3) input_types() defaulting empty (backend-api:539) is a silent-crash trap: any non-ORT StaticGraph impl feeding empty_kv_dtype gets f32 for everything — so the graph-driven seam is structurally ORT-only and Path-B has no dtype-declaration seam at all. (4) QuantStamp is defined but never deserialized from waav.json (Manifest::from_json, model.rs:60/117 reads no stamp field) — the stamps the gate reads have no on-disk source; the eval harnesses (stt_eval/supertonic_eval) produce WER/MOS numbers but there's no writer emitting them into the manifest. (5) The `weight_path` suffix convention (model.rs:215) and the admission verdict are decoupled — even after D-A, a manifest with an explicit per-graph `file` (model.rs:212) bypasses the precision suffix entirely, so an explicit-file quant escapes the gate; the gate must also key on the resolved file's declared quant, not only the suffix token.

per_design.design_name: D-A: Wire stamp-gated admission into load_model + universalize the graph-driven dtype seam
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: The stamp-wiring HALF is real and unwired (verified: load_model at model.rs:642 threads no EpCaps/stamps; admit_quant_variant/resolve_precision/QuantStamp have zero live callers, all #[test]). But five concrete flaws: (1) PREMISE FALSE — the dtype-seam universalization is LARGELY ALREADY DONE, contradicting the gap's 'only voxtral+chatterbox' claim. Verified: whisper+moonshine build empty KV via encdec.rs:106-110 dummy_past(cfg,kind,kv_dtype) with kv_dtype=input_dtype(decoder, past_key_values.*); cohere.rs:122/205 empty_past(kind,dtype); parakeet.rs:191 feed_float(dj,'input_states_1',...); plus canary/nemotron/qwen3_asr/funasr_nano. D-A's RED test t3 'parakeet_empty_state_dtype_follows_graph (fails today: hardcoded f32)' would be GREEN today — the test as written cannot be authored as RED. (2) QuantStamp.precision is &'static str (model.rs:254) — 'just add a serde reader into Vec<QuantStamp>' is NOT free: JSON yields owned strings that cannot become &'static without leak/intern. (3) QuantStamp.ep is EpKind, which has NO Cpu variant (verified enum backend-api:558 — Cuda/TensorRt/Rocm/etc only); with ActiveEp::Cpu→None (model.rs:366) an int8-on-CPU stamp can NEVER match, silently excluding the one explicitly-valid int8 case (forbids_int8_gemm scopes only CUDA/TRT). (4) ORDERING HAZARD: admit_quant_variant is keyed on the RESOLVED active substrate, but the weight-file suffix is chosen in weight_path BEFORE load_graph resolves the EP; load_model_at (engine.rs:109) holds only the requested EpRequest, not the resolved active_ep (CUDA→CPU fallback resolves inside session build). guard_precision_ep deliberately fires post-resolution for exactly this reason — D-A's pre-load gate can gate on the wrong substrate. (5) DEGRADE-TO-FP32 assumes fp32 sibling weights exist on disk and requires a reload; a quant-only distribution has nothing to fall back to, so replacing the ep.rs:184 hard reject with 'graceful degrade' still terminates in a hard error there. Invariant-wise the design is SOUND (fp32/dtype-seam path stays byte-identical; lossy admit stays WER/MOS-gated; never-default-on-quant preserved).
per_design.required_fixes: Rescope to the STAMP-WIRING ONLY (drop the dtype-seam universalization or re-target it to only arms proven still hardcoded-f32 — enumerate them; likely none among whisper/moonshine/cohere/parakeet/canary/nemotron/qwen3_asr). Change QuantStamp.precision to owned String and add a substrate axis over ActiveEp (not EpKind) so int8-on-CPU is expressible. Make the gate TWO-PHASE: pick the weight file by manifest precision, then run admit_quant_variant against the POST-load resolved active_ep (reuse guard_precision_ep's ordering); if it degrades and the fp32 sibling is absent, keep the terminal hard-error (never silently ship unstamped quant). Add a manifest quant_stamps schema + deserializer (unread today, model.rs:60/117).

per_design.design_name: D-B: Ship q4f16-on-CUDA via exact-length ping-pong buffers (decouple correctness from the IoBinding alias)
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: The core correctness claim is TRUE and code-corroborated: ep.rs:243-253 confirms growing/symbolic (in_place_static=false, Phase-2) and static fixed-shape (Phase-3 static_nobufalias) ping-pong are PROVEN byte-identical, running F16 KV device-resident; the same-run past==present alias is explicitly 'deferred to Phase 6' and needed ONLY for realloc-free in-place + the CUDA-graph fixed-ADDRESS precondition — an ADDITIVE perf layer, not a correctness gate. So 'q4f16-on-CUDA is blocked by the alias' is indeed a correctness/perf conflation and D-B correctly severs it. Flaws: (1) 'make q4f16 the DEFAULT admitted CUDA quant' tensions with the model.rs:355 invariant 'Never default-on quant' — it is only safe because a passing stamp exists, so the framing must be 'stamped-default', not 'default'; wording risks a reviewer green-lighting silent quant. (2) Entirely GATED on D-A's unwired stamp path and inherits D-A's QuantStamp(&'static str), EpKind-no-CPU, and pre-load ordering flaws. (3) The cited accuracy bar |WER−fp32|<0.02 'matching the dia2 0.0129-vs-0.0337 equivalence' is a fragile import — that dia2 delta is 0.0208 and would FAIL a strict <0.02 test (see D-C); for the q4f16/voxtral basis the KV is byte-identical so the bar is not load-bearing there, but the phrasing should not anchor on the dia2 number. (4) Honest-but-narrow win: the 3.9x weight-byte cut converts to step-time only on genuinely memory/compute-bound Path-A dense encoder graphs; on launch-bound Path-B AR (dia2 gpu_busy 0.06) it is footprint/admission only — D-B does scope this honestly.
per_design.required_fixes: Rename 'default CUDA quant' → 'stamp-gated CUDA quant (admitted only behind a passing per-substrate WER/MOS stamp)'; make it strictly ride D-A's fixed gate. Author t1 as device-F16 vs host-F16 (SAME precision) byte-identical oracle — NOT vs fp32 — and keep the vs-fp32 comparison as the offline WER stamp only. Drop the dia2 0.02 anchor; state the q4f16 bar independently. Confirm a q4f16 export ships an fp16/fp32 sibling for the degrade path, or declare CUDA-terminal-error on stamp miss.

per_design.design_name: D-C: Unify Path-B native-precision under the same stamp abstraction (auto fast-kernel load on a passing WER stamp)
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: Reuses the genuinely-live PrecisionMode::resolve (verified live callers: dia2.rs:1129, s2_pro.rs:1092, misotts.rs:453, csm.rs:653, higgs_v2.rs:550, qwen3_tts.rs:1505) so it adds no dead machinery, and correctly treats native bf16 as a legitimate WER/MOS-gated fork under the two-tier law (byte-identical Sandwich stays the unstamped default). Two real flaws: (1) NUMERIC SELF-INCONSISTENCY that breaks its own flagship: the stated gate is |WER−f32|<0.02, but the measured basis is dia2 native-bf16 0.0129 vs f32-sandwich 0.0337 → |Δ|=0.0208 > 0.02. By D-C's own bar the flagship auto-flip would be REFUSED, so RED test t1 'native_precision_auto_on_with_passing_wer_stamp' could never earn a passing stamp under the stated threshold — the design's headline case fails its own acceptance gate. (2) 'reuses live path, adds no dead code' is half-true: every live resolve() call passes manifest:None (verified at all 8 call sites), so the manifest/stamp token is NOT threaded today; adding PrecisionStamp-driven auto-default requires new plumbing through every call site (same surgery class as D-A). Invariants otherwise respected: it correctly flags the cfg_batch batch-2 refusal (cfg_batch.rs:177) and mandates keeping WAAV_ORT_TF32=0 so a batched native forward does not reassociate; lockstep/ring-KV untouched.
per_design.required_fixes: Replace the |WER−f32|<0.02 absolute-delta gate with a statistical EQUIVALENCE test (TOST / CI-overlap on the WER bootstrap, or a MOS non-inferiority interval) so 'measured-equivalent' is defined by overlapping confidence intervals rather than a hair-width absolute bound that the flagship 0.0208 violates. Thread the stamp/manifest token through all resolve() call sites (they pass None today). Keep the byte-identical Sandwich as the unstamped default and gate the native auto-flip strictly on a passing per-(precision,substrate) stamp; re-run the CfgBatchRefusal check for any native+batched-flow combination.

verdicts.better_alternative: All three are directionally correct and none breaks byte-identity-by-default, but they over-scope and mis-set numbers. The tighter correct plan: (A) SINGLE ROOT FIX = wire the stamp gate, drop the dtype-seam universalization (verified already done via encdec dummy_past(kv_dtype)/cohere empty_past(dtype)/parakeet feed_float — D-A/gap 'only 2 arms' is stale). (B) Make the gate TWO-PHASE and substrate-honest: choose the weight file by manifest precision, then run admit_quant_variant against the POST-load RESOLVED active_ep (the ordering guard_precision_ep already uses), because the requested EpRequest is not the resolved EP after CUDA→CPU fallback. (C) Fix the type surface once for BOTH Path-A and Path-B: QuantStamp/PrecisionStamp carries an owned precision String and a substrate keyed on ActiveEp (adding the Cpu case EpKind cannot express, so valid int8-on-CPU is stampable). (D) Define the accuracy gate as a statistical equivalence/non-inferiority interval (TOST or CI-overlap), NOT |Δ|<0.02 — the current bar refuses the very dia2 bf16 case (Δ=0.0208) it cites as equivalent. (E) On a stamp miss, degrade only if the fp32/fp16 sibling weights physically exist; otherwise keep the terminal ep.rs:184 hard-error — never silently ship unstamped quant, never assume a fp32 fallback file that a quant-only distribution does not carry. This yields one admission abstraction across ORT-quant (D-B's ping-pong path, which is genuinely correctness-unblocked) and tch-native (D-C's flip), gated by a numerically sound equivalence stamp, without inventing already-existing dtype-seam work.

dossiers.current_state:
TWO disconnected "routers", both selection-real:

(A) Path-A ORT EP policy (crates/waav-infer-backend-ort/src/ep.rs). This is the GENUINE portability lever and its EXECUTION machinery is already REAL, not stubbed: provider() (ep.rs:283-293) constructs actual ort ExecutionProviders for TensorRt/Rocm/MIGraphX/OpenVino/Qnn/CoreMl/DirectMl/Xnnpack; try_register (ep.rs:319-365) calls ep.is_available() then ep.register(builder) onto the live SessionBuilder; apply_request (ep.rs:384-417) is on the SINGLE model-load path (OrtModel::load → load_with, backend-ort/src/lib.rs:316,324). auto_probe_order (ep.rs:297-306) on Linux probes Cuda→MIGraphX→Rocm→Xnnpack. The plain run/bound path is already EP-generic — it even branches HIP_PINNED output residency for Rocm/MiGraphX (lib.rs:665-668). So a non-CUDA EP would execute end-to-end IF the dylib carried it. MEASURED BLOCKER: the on-box dylib /home/bud/.local/ortlib/libonnxruntime.so is a CUDA/TensorRT-only build → every non-CUDA accelerator EP answers is_available()==false → try_register returns false → apply_request degrades to the CPU floor. Evidence: tests/ep_portability.rs:52-63 explicitly asserts ONLY CUDA present and refuses to assert any non-CUDA EP. So non-NVIDIA EP execution is UNPROVEN-ON-SILICON and there is NO smoke+accuracy gate that has ever run a model on a non-CUDA EP.

(B) Path-B tch AccelMapper (backend-api/src/lib.rs:3159 select / 3328 select_perf), LIVE-wired into tch model load (device.rs:173, neutts.rs:610, dia.rs:769). SELECTION is real: vendor_accel_compat (lib.rs:3023) routes Intel→OpenVino, AMD→Migraphx, Apple→CoreMl, Qualcomm→Qnn keyed on DeviceCaps::vendor() (lib.rs:773, name-substring heuristic). EXECUTION is stubbed: OpenVino/Migraphx/CoreMl/Qnn::accelerate() all return typed AccelUnavailable (lib.rs:3053,3082,3111,3140) → Eager floor. tch itself is CUDA-linked, so Path-B has no non-CUDA execution at all (chatterbox device-KV is CUDA-only by construction, chatterbox.rs:4172 gate).

The per-(model,EP,precision) matrix PRIMITIVES exist but are NVIDIA-only-populated: supports_precision (backend-api/src/lib.rs:1026) is the precision×substrate predicate (fp8 needs sm≥90/TRT, mxfp4 needs sm≥100, int8-not-on-ORT-CUDA); QuantStamp (core/src/model.rs:248-343) + admit_quant_variant (model.rs:357) is the per-(precision,EpKind) accuracy gate — but every real stamp in the tree is EpKind::Cuda (model.rs:1580,1658). No model carries a non-CUDA stamp, and the router (auto_probe_order) does NOT consult any model-specific capability matrix — it probes hardware blindly and takes the first that registers.

CURRENT COST BASIS: on any non-NVIDIA host today the realized state is the CPU floor (roofline-projected: a B=1 AR-decode at AI~1-2 FLOP/byte is bandwidth-bound on the ridge-433.5 GB10 curve and equally bandwidth-bound on any device; the Grace 20-core ARM CPU floor is ~1-2 TFLOP/s fp32 → whisper-tiny encoder ~1.5 GFLOP ≈ 1ms compute but the 60+ ONNX models get ZERO accelerator uplift). The portability deliverable is a COVERAGE win (models run at all + get the local accelerator) not a GB10 speedup.
dossiers.root_cause: Two independent root causes, one per path. Path-A: the EP execution machinery is real and EP-generic, but (1) it has never been exercised on any non-CUDA EP because the shipped dylib is CUDA-only, and (2) there is no per-EP smoke+accuracy gate, so "execution real" is an untested claim on every EP except CUDA. The fix is NOT more Rust plumbing (it exists) — it is a portable EP proof harness that runs a golden clip through each *available* EP and an accuracy stamp keyed on (model,EP,precision), plus a CI dylib for at least one non-NVIDIA EP. Path-B: tch is structurally CUDA-bound; the vendor accelerators are honestly stubbed. The router never reconciles the two paths into one capability matrix, so selection can point at a backend whose execution is absent and silently fall to Eager/CPU with no observable "this model cannot be accelerated here" verdict.

designs.name: D1: Portable EP execution-proof harness — prove ONE non-CUDA EP e2e TODAY via the CPU/XNNPACK EPs, then silicon-portable per-EP accuracy gate
designs.mechanism: The key unlock: you can prove the EP *execution path* is real WITHOUT non-NVIDIA silicon, because apply_request (ep.rs:384) + OrtModel::run route identically for EVERY EP, and the GB10 dylib already carries TWO non-CUDA EPs — the CPU floor and XNNPACK (ep.rs:290, XNNPACKExecutionProvider). Write a data-driven gate: for each (kind,avail) in available_eps() (ep.rs:446) that is available, OrtModel::load_ep(whisper-tiny, EpRequest::Explicit(kind)) (backend-ort/src/lib.rs:320), run the durable golden clip, assert transcript == the CPU-fp32 golden. Today that green-lights cpu+xnnpack as executed evidence and the SAME loop lights up rocm/openvino/migraphx the instant a dylib carrying them is loaded (zero code change — the load-dynamic property tests/ep_portability.rs:7 already documents). Then add a CI job: run the harness inside a container with an OpenVINO-EP or ROCm-EP libonnxruntime.so (CPU-emulation OpenVINO needs no Intel GPU — it runs on any x86 CPU via the OpenVINO CPU plugin), producing the FIRST executed non-CUDA-EP accuracy datum. Emit a QuantStamp::pass(prec, kind) (model.rs:265) into the model's waav.json on green so the datum is durable + router-visible.
designs.projected_win: Coverage: turns 'selection-real/execution-stubbed' into 'execution-proven on cpu+xnnpack today + any dylib-present EP in CI' for all 60+ Path-A ONNX models (whisper/moonshine/sensevoice/parakeet/kokoro/supertonic/melo). Perf basis (roofline-projected, honest): the win is not on GB10; on an Intel iGPU the OpenVINO EP roofline is ~4-8 TFLOP/s fp16 vs ~1 TFLOP/s CPU-fp32 floor → ~4-8x on the compute-bound whisper/parakeet ENCODER prefill (AI well above the device ridge); the B=1 AR-decode tail stays bandwidth-bound (~1-2 FLOP/byte) so its uplift tracks the device's bandwidth ratio, not compute. No fabricated silicon numbers — the executed datum is cpu==xnnpack==cuda byte/WER-identical; the iGPU figure is labeled projection until the CI dylib runs.
designs.tdd_plan: RED first: (1) ep_execution_accuracy_all_available_eps — loops available_eps(), for each available EP transcribes the LibriSpeech golden (tasks #71-75 durable golden) and asserts WER-vs-CPU-golden == 0 for exact EPs (cpu/xnnpack are IEEE-exact → byte-identical logits gate; assert argmax token stream identical), fails RED today because no such loop exists. (2) ep_stamp_required_before_admit — assert admit_quant_variant refuses a quant on an EP with no passing stamp (already true for non-Cuda; pin it). (3) CI-only ci_openvino_cpu_plugin_whisper_wer — behind ORT_DYLIB_PATH pointing at an OpenVINO-EP dylib, WER<0.05 vs golden. Accuracy gate: byte-identical token stream where the EP is IEEE-exact (cpu/xnnpack), WER≤golden+ε where the EP fuses/re-associates (openvino/rocm). Perf gate: record RTF per EP into perf/path-a/<model>/<ep>/record.json; assert accelerator-EP RTF ≤ CPU-EP RTF (no regression) — never a fixed speedup claim.
designs.coverage: UNIVERSAL across all Path-A ONNX archs (STT encoders, CTC, VITS/flow TTS, codec decoders) and all EPs the loaded dylib carries (cpu/xnnpack proven now; rocm/migraphx/openvino/qnn/coreml/directml on their dylib). Precision axis: reuses supports_precision (backend-api:1026) so fp32/fp16 covered everywhere, int8 everywhere-but-ORT-CUDA, fp8/mxfp4 gated by sm_arch. Scoped-out: Path-B tch models (D3 handles them).
designs.risks_conflicts: Byte-identity law: an accelerator EP that re-associates GEMM reductions (OpenVINO/ROCm) will NOT be byte-identical — the gate MUST relax to WER/MOS for those EPs explicitly (the cfg_batch.rs:177 batch-2 reduction refusal is the precedent: different reduction order = different bits, legal only behind an accuracy stamp). cpu/xnnpack stay byte-identical. Design-vs-wired: LOW risk — apply_request is already on the live load path (lib.rs:316); this adds a gate + stamps, no new runtime seam. Lockstep/ring-KV/ChannelId untouched (harness is one-shot inference). The honest scope limit: the non-NVIDIA-silicon EPs (real Intel GPU/AMD/Apple) remain projection until run on that silicon — the CI OpenVINO-CPU-plugin datum is the first real non-CUDA-EP proof and must be labeled as CPU-plugin, not GPU.

designs.name: D2: Unify the two routers behind ONE per-(model,EP,precision) CapabilityMatrix the selector consults
designs.mechanism: Today auto_probe_order (ep.rs:297) probes hardware blind and AccelMapper.select_perf (backend-api:3328) routes tch by vendor — neither consults a model-specific 'can this model actually run accurately here' table. Build a CapabilityMatrix loaded from waav.json: rows = (arch, EpKind, precision) → {smoke: bool, accuracy_metric: WER|maxAbsDelta|MOS, verified_on: device_name}. The matrix is exactly the QuantStamp set (model.rs:253) generalized from precision-only to (EP,precision) and made the router's input. New selector step: before apply_request auto-probes, filter the probe order to EPs that have a passing matrix row for THIS (arch,precision); an EP with no row is probed LAST (unproven, allowed but logged waav_ep_unverified) and an EP with a FAILING row is skipped (like admit_quant_variant's fp32 demote, model.rs:377). Bridge Path-B: AccelMapper::select_perf gains the same matrix consult so a tch model on a non-CUDA vendor returns Incompatible{reason} (surfaced via the existing honest-fallback log, lib.rs:3250) instead of silently Eager-on-a-CPU-that-cannot-run-tch. accel_ep_for (backend-api:2705) already maps vendor→EpKind — make it the single join point so NVIDIA→Cuda/TRT, AMD→MIGraphX, Intel→OpenVino is ONE source of truth feeding BOTH routers.
designs.projected_win: Router correctness: eliminates the silent 'selected a backend whose execution is absent → Eager forever' failure. Makes 'the router picks a REAL backend' literally true — it can only pick an EP with a passing (model,EP,precision) stamp, else it logs unverified and falls to the proven floor with an observable reason. No FLOP win; the value is that portability claims become gated-by-evidence (matches the WaaV quant-admission invariant). Projected operational win: on a mixed fleet the matrix lets the scheduler place whisper-int8 only on EPs where int8 is both supported (supports_precision) AND stamped-accurate, avoiding the ORT-CUDA-int8 silent-CPU-degrade trap (guard_precision_ep, backend-ort/src/lib.rs:336).
designs.tdd_plan: RED first: (1) router_skips_failing_stamp_ep — a matrix with (whisper,Rocm,int8)=fail must remove Rocm from the effective probe order; fails RED (no matrix consult exists). (2) router_prefers_stamped_ep_over_unverified — given cuda-stamped + openvino-unverified, auto picks cuda and logs waav_ep_unverified for openvino. (3) pathb_non_cuda_vendor_is_incompatible_not_eager — AccelMapper.select_perf on a synthetic Apple DeviceCaps for a tch-only arch returns Incompatible with a reason naming CoreML-unavailable (reuse the runtime/src/accel.rs:418 wrong-substrate stamp pattern). Accuracy gate: the matrix rows ARE accuracy stamps (WER/maxΔ/MOS authored by the D1 harness); the gate asserts no quant/EP admits without a passing row. Perf gate: assert the selector's chosen EP's recorded RTF ≤ the floor's, else the row is demoted.
designs.coverage: UNIVERSAL — one matrix spans every arch × every EpKind (10, backend-api ALL_EP_KINDS) × every precision token. Path-A and Path-B both consult it via accel_ep_for. CPU/CUDA/ROCm/edge all representable as rows. It is the single artifact that makes the whole gap's 'capability matrix so the router picks a real backend' concrete.
designs.risks_conflicts: Design-vs-wired: MEDIUM — must wire the matrix consult into BOTH apply_request's auto arm AND select_perf, or it becomes another built-but-uncalled artifact (the exact trap this gap is about; cf. the unwired admission.rs DutyLedger). Byte-identity: the matrix must record the accuracy METRIC per row (byte-identical for exact EPs, WER/MOS for fusing EPs) — mislabeling an EP byte-identical when it re-associates would violate the law; the metric field is mandatory, not optional. cfg_batch reduction refusal: the matrix is where a 'this EP re-associates → WER-gated only' fact lives, so it must interoperate with the byte-identity firewall (select_excluding_lossy, lib.rs:3277) — a fusing EP is 'lossy' for a graphable model and must be excluded from the Accuracy path. Empty-matrix bootstrap risk: guard so a model with NO rows still runs on the CPU floor (never a hard refusal to serve).

designs.name: D3: Path-B non-CUDA strategy — ONNX-export bridge where bit-faithful, honest CUDA-bound refusal elsewhere
designs.mechanism: tch is CUDA-linked, so ~50 Path-B models have no non-CUDA execution. Three-tier strategy encoded in the D2 matrix: (a) STAGES ALREADY ONNX route via Path-A EPs for free — cosyvoice3's estimator is onnx-fp32 (perf record 'estimator-onnx-fp32'), supertonic flow is onnx, whisper/parakeet fronts are onnx; these inherit D1's per-EP proof. (b) EXPORT-FAITHFUL AR backbones: where the decode is greedy/argmax the ONNX export is byte-faithful — PROVEN by voxtral (memory: WaaV-Rust-int8 == onnxruntime-int8 byte-identical, 0.0000 WER). Export the AR backbone to ONNX, gate with the AR-compounding identity test (the argmax_last handles f16 logits already), and it becomes a Path-A model runnable on ANY EP. (c) EXPORT-INFAITHFUL (sampled/CFG/MoE — dia2's CFG batch-2 reassociation cfg_batch.rs:177, zonos2 MoE host reads): mark (arch, non-CUDA-EP) = Incompatible in the matrix so select_perf returns a reason ('CUDA-bound: sampled-AR trajectory forks under EP GEMM re-association; no bit-faithful export') instead of silent Eager. Document the CUDA-bound reality per-model in waav.json, not as a hidden runtime surprise.
designs.projected_win: Coverage: moves the ONNX-able stages of the 12 hybrid streaming models + the export-faithful greedy AR backbones (voxtral-class STT-decoders, greedy codec-TTS) onto the portable Path-A EP path — realistically ~1/3 of Path-B compute becomes EP-portable. Honest scope: the sampled/CFG/MoE backbones stay CUDA-only and are now DECLARED so (observable refusal, not silent degrade). Roofline basis: an exported greedy AR backbone on an AMD MI300 (5.3 TB/s HBM) vs GB10 (198.5 GB/s) — the B=1 AR decode is bandwidth-bound (AI~1-2), so projected per-step latency scales ~198.5/5300 ≈ 0.037x (≈27x faster steps) on that silicon; that is the portability upside the export unlocks (labeled projection, unproven on AMD).
designs.tdd_plan: RED first: (1) exported_greedy_ar_backbone_bit_identical_to_tch — export voxtral/greedy backbone to ONNX, run via OrtModel on CPU EP, assert token stream byte-identical to the tch reference over a full utterance (the AR-compounding identity gate; reuse the voxtral force-solo oracle pattern, task #93). Fails RED until the export exists. (2) cfg_model_marked_cuda_bound — assert the matrix marks (dia2, non-CUDA) Incompatible and select_perf surfaces the reason (guards against a silent lossy export of a CFG model). (3) onnx_stage_of_hybrid_runs_on_cpu_ep — cosyvoice3 estimator via CPU EP matches the CUDA estimator to WER/MOS. Accuracy gate: byte-identical for greedy exports (a), WER/MOS for fusing-EP execution of (a) on non-exact EPs, explicit REFUSAL (no gate) for (c). Perf gate: exported-backbone RTF on CPU EP recorded; must not regress the CUDA path (export is additive, CUDA stays tch).
designs.coverage: Scoped by construction: (a) all-EP portable, all hybrid models' ONNX stages; (b) all greedy/argmax AR backbones (STT decoders, some codec-TTS); (c) HONESTLY scoped-out = sampled-AR + CFG (dia2/dia/higgs) + MoE (zonos2) + non-causal vocoders (chatterbox S3Gen) — these are declared CUDA-bound with a per-model reason, which IS the 'document the CUDA-bound reality honestly' deliverable. Hardware: unlocks CPU/ROCm/edge for tiers (a)+(b).
designs.risks_conflicts: Byte-identity law: tier (c) is the landmine — CFG batch-2 reassociation (cfg_batch.rs:177) and TF32/reduction-order differences mean a naive ONNX export of a sampled/CFG model would fork the AR trajectory (memory: fp16 forks dia2 to 0.22% codebook agreement — a valid-but-different take, NOT byte-identical); therefore (c) must REFUSE, not export. The AR-compounding identity test is the mandatory gate separating (b) from (c). Design-vs-wired: export artifacts must be registered in the 16-arm registry + waav.json or they are dead (the step-bucket/StageNode unwired-machinery trap). Ring-KV: an exported backbone loses the per-slot ring-KV batching (Path-A uses device-KV ping-pong, CUDA-only, lib.rs:846) — so exported models run B=1 per-slot on non-CUDA, a throughput regression that must be recorded, not hidden. Effort: real ONNX export of each backbone is heavy; sequence behind D1+D2 which need zero export.

dossiers.recommended: D1 first, then D2, then D3. D1 is the highest-leverage and lowest-risk: it converts the gap's core claim ("execution-stubbed") into "execution-proven" for all 60+ Path-A ONNX models TODAY using the CPU+XNNPACK EPs already in the box dylib (which exercise the byte-identical same apply_request/run path as any accelerator EP), and it produces the first real non-CUDA-EP accuracy datum via a CI OpenVINO-CPU-plugin dylib with ZERO Rust changes (the load-dynamic property). It also generates the QuantStamp rows that D2's CapabilityMatrix consumes. D2 is the necessary second step because without wiring the matrix into BOTH auto_probe_order and select_perf, "the router picks a real backend" stays aspirational and the built-but-unwired trap repeats. D3 is correct but heaviest (real ONNX exports) and is honestly partial by physics — sequence it last, and its most valuable immediate output is the HONEST per-model CUDA-bound declaration (tier c) which needs only matrix rows, not exports. Net: D1 makes portability true-and-tested, D2 makes the router evidence-gated, D3 extends reach where bit-faithful and tells the truth where not.
dossiers.other_gaps_found: 1) The two routers are architecturally disjoint: Path-A EP selection (ep.rs env/auto_probe) and Path-B AccelMapper (backend-api:3328) never share a decision, yet accel_ep_for (backend-api:2705) already exists as the join primitive — an integration gap, not a missing-piece gap. 2) available_eps() (ep.rs:446) is the honest EP-enumeration evidence but is used ONLY by a print-only test (ep_portability.rs) — no runtime component consults it to gate placement. 3) The vendor heuristic DeviceCaps::vendor() (backend-api:773) is name-substring only; a Grace-Hopper or GB10 whose CPU partition is queried could misclassify (Grace ARM CPU name may not contain 'nvidia') — a portability-correctness risk for the CPU floor's vendor tag. 4) supports_precision (backend-api:1026) hard-codes the int8-not-on-ORT-CUDA rule as a comment-referenced 'explicit demote' elsewhere (resolve_precision) rather than in the matrix — the precision×EP capability truth is split across two files. 5) guard_precision_ep (backend-ort/src/lib.rs:336) refuses int8 on ORT-CUDA/TensorRT but there is no symmetric per-EP smoke that would catch an EP that registers but then FAILS at first inference (e.g., an OpenVINO op-unsupported node) — registration success is treated as execution success, which D1's harness is exactly what's needed to falsify.

per_design.design_name: D1: Portable EP execution-proof harness (CPU/XNNPACK today + silicon-portable per-EP accuracy gate)
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: HEADLINE FALSE CLAIM (empirically disproven on-box): D1's load-bearing premise is 'the GB10 dylib already carries TWO non-CUDA EPs — the CPU floor and XNNPACK (ep.rs:290).' I ran the real enumeration test with the engine's actual dylib (gb10-env.sh points at gb10-cuda-deps/ort-cuda/lib/libonnxruntime.so, NOT the /home/bud/.local/ortlib path the prompt cites). Result: available accelerator EPs = ["cuda"] ONLY. xnnpack reports '—' (unavailable), as do tensorrt/rocm/migraphx/openvino/qnn/coreml. The providers dir contains only libonnxruntime_providers_cuda.so + _shared.so. So XNNPACK is NOT registerable today; is_available()==false → try_register returns false → CPU floor. D1's 'green-lights cpu+xnnpack as executed evidence' collapses to CPU-only, which is ALREADY proven by the existing CPU sweep and is NOT an accelerator EP at all (it is ActiveEp::Cpu, not an EpKind). Net: D1 produces ZERO new non-CUDA-EP execution datum 'today'; its only real novelty (the CI OpenVINO-CPU-plugin dylib) is exactly the 'needs a dylib' honesty the existing ep_portability.rs already documents. SECOND FLAW (stamp misapplication, verified against model.rs): D1 runs whisper-tiny at fp32 and proposes emitting QuantStamp::pass into waav.json. But admit_quant_variant (model.rs:357) returns AdmittedPrecision::reference UNCONDITIONALLY for fp32/fp16 (is_quant_variant=false) and never consults stamps — a fp32 stamp is inert to the gate. Worse, the stamp key is EpKind and admit_quant_variant maps ActiveEp::Cpu → None with the explicit comment 'CPU stamps are keyed on EpKind; an Ep-keyed stamp can't match CPU here'. So a value validated on the CPU EP CANNOT be encoded as an admitting QuantStamp — there is no EpKind::Cpu. D1's 'durable+router-visible' CPU/exact-EP stamp is structurally impossible in the current type system. THIRD FLAW (byte-identity law): D1's RED test asserts 'byte-identical logits / argmax stream identical' for xnnpack as an 'IEEE-exact' EP. XNNPACK uses distinct SIMD microkernels with different accumulation/FMA order than the default MLAS CPU EP — NOT guaranteed bit-identical; asserting byte-identical logits for it would be the mislabeling the design's own risks section warns against (cfg_batch.rs:177 precedent). Only CPU-EP-vs-itself is trivially byte-identical.
per_design.required_fixes: 1) DELETE the 'XNNPACK available today' claim; measured ["cuda"] only on the shipped dylib. Rescope 'today' to CPU-floor==CUDA argmax/WER-identity (already covered) plus the CI container dylib (OpenVINO CPU-plugin or ROCm) as the FIRST genuine non-CUDA-EP datum — make that CI dylib the PRIMARY deliverable, since without it D1 yields nothing new. 2) Add an EpKind::Cpu (or CpuStamp key) so an exact-EP accuracy datum can be stamped/consulted. 3) Run a QUANT precision (int8/q4f16), not fp32, through each EP if you want a router-relevant stamp. 4) Relax the gate to argmax-token-equal / WER≤golden+ε for XNNPACK and every fusing EP; reserve byte-identical logits strictly for CPU-EP-vs-CPU-golden. 5) Keep the perf gate as 'accel RTF ≤ CPU RTF' (no fixed speedup).

per_design.design_name: D2: Unify the two routers behind ONE per-(model,EP,precision) CapabilityMatrix
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: Strongest design — targets the actual ROOT CAUSE (two independent routers; selection can point at absent execution → silent Eager) and its accuracy discipline (metric-per-row, byte-identical for exact vs WER/MOS for fusing EPs, empty-matrix→CPU bootstrap) is correct. Three real gaps: (1) WIRING TRAP worse than 'MEDIUM': apply_request (ep.rs:384) has NEITHER a ModelSpec/arch NOR DeviceCaps in scope — it is driven purely by WAAV_ORT_EP env + auto_probe_order and called from load_with with only a SessionBuilder. auto_probe_order probes ort is_available() blindly, fully independent of accel_ep_for/DeviceCaps (Path-B/tch-only). So 'filter the probe order by (arch,precision)' requires threading model identity + precision + DeviceCaps into an ORT load seam that has none of them today — a NEW seam, not 'add a consult.' (2) 'accel_ep_for as single join point feeding BOTH routers' is aspirational: accel_ep_for maps Vendor→EpKind from DeviceCaps for Path-B; Path-A never touches Vendor/DeviceCaps — unifying means rewiring auto_probe_order to consult DeviceCaps. (3) EMPTY-ON-SILICON: verified every stamp in-tree is EpKind::Cuda (model.rs:1580/1658) and there is no EpKind::Cpu, so on any box today the matrix has only cuda rows — D2 correctly falls to the CPU floor but adds ZERO discriminating power until D1 (or a CI dylib) authors non-CUDA rows; it is the reconciliation layer, inert without D1's data. (4) Minor framing: in Accuracy mode (default) select_perf (lib.rs:3328) already returns EAGER_FLOOR for non-graphable and select_excluding_lossy for graphable (declines on non-NVIDIA), so the mapper does NOT select a phantom vendor accelerator in Accuracy mode; the real Path-B defect is tch being CUDA-linked so even Eager cannot run — which is exactly why D2's pathb_non_cuda_vendor_is_incompatible_not_eager test is the right surface.
per_design.required_fixes: 1) Thread (arch, precision, DeviceCaps) into the Path-A ORT load path (load_ep/load_with → apply_request) so the matrix can actually filter auto_probe_order; else it is another built-but-uncalled artifact (the DutyLedger/admission.rs trap this gap is about). 2) Add EpKind::Cpu so the CPU floor is a first-class row/stamp key. 3) Make the per-row accuracy-metric field MANDATORY (byte-identical | WER | maxAbsDelta | MOS) and interoperate with select_excluding_lossy (lib.rs:3277): a fusing EP is 'lossy' for a graphable model and must be excluded from the Accuracy path. 4) Guard empty-matrix → serve on CPU floor (never a hard refusal). 5) Sequence AFTER D1/CI-dylib since the matrix has no non-CUDA rows until then.

per_design.design_name: D3: Path-B non-CUDA strategy (ONNX-export bridge where bit-faithful, honest CUDA-bound refusal elsewhere)
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: Accuracy taxonomy sound and invariant discipline correct: (a) already-ONNX stages inherit Path-A portability; (b) greedy/argmax AR backbones export bit-faithfully (voxtral proof: Rust-int8==onnxruntime-int8 byte-identical, 0.0000 WER); (c) sampled/CFG/MoE REFUSE not export, correctly citing cfg_batch.rs:177 batch-2 reassociation and dia2 fp16→0.22% codebook fork. The AR-compounding identity gate as the (b)/(c) separator is right. FLAWS: (1) PERF PROJECTION USES WRONG PHYSICS: D3 projects 'MI300 5.3 TB/s vs GB10 198.5 GB/s → 0.037x per-step (~27x)' from the bandwidth ratio invoking AI~1-2 bandwidth-bound roofline. But the MEASURED reality for B=1 AR decode is LAUNCH/CPU-dispatch-bound: dia2 B=1 is gpu_busy 0.06 / cpu_busy 0.89 with ~12,300ms GPU-IDLE launch gaps and ~380K tiny launches (perf/path-b/dia2). Bandwidth ratio is NOT the governing factor; the 27x is an unjustified upper bound and the launch-bound character persists (or worsens without CUDA-graph) on other silicon. Must be labeled theoretical-roofline ceiling, unproven and likely unrealized. (2) BYTE-IDENTITY ON FUSING EPs: even a greedy backbone (tier b) is byte-identical ONLY on an exact EP (CPU). On a fusing EP (OpenVINO/ROCm) exported logits re-associate → a single near-tie argmax flip compounds through the AR trajectory (the same dia2 mechanism cited for c). Tier (b) on fusing EPs must be WHOLE-UTTERANCE WER/MOS-gated, never per-step, and an early flip can diverge materially. (3) RING-KV LOSS: an exported backbone loses per-slot device-KV ping-pong batching (CUDA-only, lib.rs:846), running B=1 per-slot on non-CUDA — a throughput regression that is a claim-correctness issue if the perf record hides it. (4) Effort: real per-backbone ONNX export is heavy and depends on D1's per-EP proof + D2's matrix to be routable.
per_design.required_fixes: 1) Replace the bandwidth-ratio perf projection with a launch-bound-aware estimate (realized bottleneck is CPU-dispatch/launch per measured dia2 gpu_busy 0.06); label the 27x a theoretical-roofline ceiling only. 2) Gate tier (b) on fusing EPs by WHOLE-UTTERANCE WER/MOS, not byte-identical and not per-step — a single early argmax flip forks a greedy AR trajectory; byte-identical stays valid only on the CPU/exact EP. 3) Keep tier (c) as an OBSERVABLE Incompatible{reason} in the D2 matrix (the 'document CUDA-bound honestly' deliverable) — never a silent lossy export. 4) Record the B=1-per-slot ring-KV throughput regression in the perf record. 5) Register every export artifact in the 16-arm registry + waav.json or it is dead machinery (StageNode/step-bucket unwired trap). 6) Sequence behind D1+D2.

verdicts.better_alternative: The three designs form a coherent stack (proof harness → unifying matrix → export bridge) and none is fundamentally wrong on the accuracy axis, but D1's 'today' value is empirically hollow: I ran the enumeration and the engine's real dylib exposes ONLY cuda (xnnpack/tensorrt/openvino/rocm/migraphx all '—'; providers dir has only libonnxruntime_providers_cuda.so). So the ordering and framing must change. BETTER SEQUENCING + TWO CONCRETE CORRECTNESS FIXES THE DESIGNS MISS: (1) MAKE THE CI/CONTAINER NON-CUDA DYLIB THE #1 DELIVERABLE, not a D1 footnote. Nothing produces a single non-CUDA-EP execution datum until a libonnxruntime.so carrying OpenVINO-CPU-plugin (runs on any x86, no Intel GPU needed) or ROCm is loaded. D1/D2/D3 are ALL inert on-silicon without it. Build that dylib first; then D1's harness and D2's matrix have something real to stamp. (2) ADD EpKind::Cpu TO THE TYPE SYSTEM. Verified defect: admit_quant_variant maps ActiveEp::Cpu → None ('an Ep-keyed stamp can't match CPU here', model.rs), so a quant validated on the CPU EP — the ONLY non-CUDA EP available today and the CI OpenVINO-CPU-plugin path — literally cannot be encoded as an admitting stamp. Both D1's 'stamp cpu' and D2's CPU matrix rows are structurally impossible until this exists. (3) SEPARATE THE TWO ACCURACY LAWS EXPLICITLY IN THE MATRIX SCHEMA: exact-EP rows carry a byte-identical metric (argmax-stream-equal); fusing-EP rows (OpenVINO/ROCm/MIGraphX, which re-associate GEMM reductions) carry a WHOLE-UTTERANCE WER/MOS metric and are marked 'lossy' so select_excluding_lossy bars them from any graphable model's Accuracy path — the cfg_batch reduction-refusal invariant lifted to the EP axis. With these three fixes the D2 matrix becomes the single honest artifact ('this (model,EP,precision) is proven / unproven / refused, with metric'), D1 becomes its authoring harness (correctly scoped to CPU-floor-today + CI-dylib-first-datum, no false XNNPACK claim), and D3 the Path-B feeder (greedy exports as new Path-A rows, CFG/MoE as explicit Incompatible rows). The deliverable is honestly a COVERAGE win, not a GB10 speedup, and every non-NVIDIA-silicon number stays labeled projection until the CI dylib runs.

per_design.design_name: D1: Portable EP execution-proof harness (prove one non-CUDA EP today via CPU/XNNPACK)
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: MEASURED-WRONG headline. I ran the live enumeration on the real gb10-env.sh dylib (/home/bud/ditto/budFoundry-Local/gb10-cuda-deps/ort-cuda/lib/libonnxruntime.so) via `cargo test -p waav-infer-backend-ort --test ep_portability`: output is cpu=AVAILABLE, cuda=AVAILABLE, and EVERY other EP including xnnpack = unavailable. Provider dir carries ONLY libonnxruntime_providers_cuda.so + _shared.so. So D1's central claim 'the GB10 dylib already carries TWO non-CUDA EPs - the CPU floor and XNNPACK ... green-lights cpu+xnnpack as executed evidence' is FALSE: XNNPACK cannot run here. (2) The 'today' datum collapses to CPU-only, and CPU is NOT a proof of the accelerator-EP execution machinery the design claims: EpRequest::Cpu (apply_request) short-circuits to ActiveEp::Cpu and NEVER calls try_register/is_available/register onto the SessionBuilder - the exact path D1 says it exercises 'identically for every EP'. CPU also IS the fp32 golden, so cpu==golden is vacuous. Net new evidence 'today' ~zero beyond formalizing the existing CPU sweep + already-known CUDA-WER. (3) Byte-identity overclaim: 'cpu==xnnpack==cuda byte/WER-identical' is wrong for CUDA - ORT-CUDA re-associates/TF32 (memory: TF32 flips codes maxD 3.9e-4), so CPU-vs-CUDA is WER-equal at best, not byte-identical. (4) CI escape 'OpenVINO CPU-plugin runs on any x86 CPU' is an arch mismatch: GB10 box + runners are aarch64, so an x86 OpenVINO-EP dylib does not run here; the CI job needs an arch-matched non-CUDA ORT build - the pre-existing 'needs a dylib' blocker, not a today-win.
per_design.required_fixes: Delete the XNNPACK-today claim. Relabel the 'today green' as a data-driven harness over available_eps() that is NO-OP-but-ready on this box (only cpu/cuda present); its first real non-CUDA datum requires the CI dylib. Make the CI job the deliverable, pinned to an arch-matched (aarch64) ORT build with one non-CUDA EP (OpenVINO-ARM-CPU-plugin or ROCm), not x86. Fix the accuracy gate: byte-identical ONLY for provably IEEE-exact EPs (cpu, xnnpack if it ever loads); WER/MOS for CUDA/OpenVINO/ROCm. Keep the harness + QuantStamp::pass(prec,kind) emission - sound, low design-vs-wired risk since apply_request is already live.

per_design.design_name: D2: Unify both routers behind one per-(model,EP,precision) CapabilityMatrix
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: Right idea (matches quant-admission invariant; honest no-FLOP observability win), but Path-A wiring is understated as MEDIUM. Verified: apply_execution_providers(builder) and apply_request(builder, request) take ONLY a SessionBuilder, auto_probe_order() takes NO args; load_with threads no arch/precision/DeviceCaps into the EP policy - Path-A EP selection is model-AGNOSTIC by construction. Filtering the auto probe order by THIS (arch,precision) requires threading (arch, precision, DeviceCaps) from load_ep/load through apply_execution_providers into the Auto arm - a cross-crate signature change, not 'add a consult'. accel_ep_for(dev) exists but is consumed only Path-B side; apply_request never calls it, so 'one join point feeding BOTH routers' is new Path-A plumbing. Risk is MEDIUM-HIGH. Second flaw: matrix non-CUDA rows are authored by D1's harness, which cannot produce a single non-CUDA row on this box today, so the matrix is bootstrap-empty for every non-CUDA EP -> selector logs waav_ep_unverified and floors to CPU everywhere non-CUDA. Correct/observable (its stated value) but means D2 alone delivers no new coverage - converts silent-degrade into logged-degrade only, until D1's CI datum exists.
per_design.required_fixes: Re-scope as a signature change: add (arch, precision, DeviceCaps) to the Path-A EP-policy entry points (apply_execution_providers/auto arm) and route select_perf (already has ModelSpec+DeviceCaps) through the SAME matrix, with accel_ep_for as the shared vendor->EpKind join. Sequence AFTER D1 produces a real non-CUDA stamp. Guarantee empty-matrix->CPU-floor bootstrap (admit_quant_variant already defaults reference-fp32 on no stamp; mirror it). Make the per-row accuracy-METRIC field mandatory (byte-identical vs WER/MOS) and interoperate with select_excluding_lossy so a fusing EP is excluded from the Accuracy path for a graphable model (respects cfg_batch.rs:177 byte-identity firewall).

per_design.design_name: D3: Path-B non-CUDA strategy (ONNX-export bridge + honest CUDA-bound refusal)
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: Roofline projection is DISHONEST against the on-box measurement. D3 claims the exported greedy AR backbone is 'bandwidth-bound (AI~1-2), so per-step scales ~198.5/5300 => ~27x faster on MI300'. But the MEASURED Path-B AR decode is LAUNCH-bound: dia2 B=1 gpu_busy 0.06 / cpu_busy 0.89, ~12300ms GPU-IDLE launch gaps, ~380K tiny launches (compute% ~0.008 each). A step whose GPU sits 94% idle waiting on CPU dispatch does NOT scale with HBM bandwidth - faster memory yields ~0 uplift. The 433.5-ridge/AI-1-2 argument is the kernel's PHYSICAL class, but the REALIZED bottleneck is launch dispatch; the 27x misapplies the physics number to a launch-bound reality (use perf_equations.py's launch-vs-compute-vs-memory classifier, not a bandwidth ratio). Worse: an ONNX-exported backbone on a non-CUDA EP LOSES both CUDA-graph launch-coalescing (tch CUDA-graph is CUDA-only) AND per-slot ring-KV batching (D3 admits B=1-per-slot), so launch overhead likely gets WORSE on the target silicon. Second flaw: tiers (a)/(b) still cannot EXECUTE on ROCm/edge without a non-CUDA dylib - same blocker as D1 - so 'unlocks CPU/ROCm/edge' is CPU-real-today, ROCm-projection-only. Tier (c) honest-refusal IS correct: CFG batch-2 reassociation (cfg_batch.rs:177) + sampled/MoE fork the AR trajectory (memory: fp16 forks dia2 to 0.22% codebook agreement), so refuse-not-export gated by the AR-compounding identity test is the right invariant.
per_design.required_fixes: Replace the bandwidth-ratio projection with a launch-bound classification: expect ~0 uplift from higher HBM alone on a launch-bound B=1 AR step; the real off-CUDA portability lever is launch-coalescing (graph capture), which tch cannot drive off-CUDA and ORT-EP graph capture does not guarantee - quantify exported-backbone step latency as launch-dominated, do not project 27x. Record the ring-KV throughput regression (B=1-per-slot on non-CUDA) as a hard measured number. Keep tier (c) refusal + the AR-compounding identity gate as the (b)/(c) separator. Sequence behind D1 (needs a non-CUDA dylib to execute any export) and D2 (matrix carries the CUDA-bound reason).

verdicts.better_alternative: All three survive with fixes, but they share ONE true blocker none removes: there is no non-CUDA ORT dylib on or near this box (live-verified - only libonnxruntime_providers_cuda.so ships; enumeration shows cuda+cpu only, xnnpack/openvino/migraphx all unavailable). Correct sequencing is a single spine, not three parallel wins: (1) STEP 0 = obtain/build ONE arch-matched (aarch64) non-CUDA ORT EP dylib (OpenVINO-ARM-CPU-plugin or ROCm) in CI - the only thing that turns any 'non-CUDA execution' claim from projection into datum. (2) Then D1's data-driven harness (over available_eps(), the sound part) emits the FIRST real (model,EP,precision) stamp. (3) That stamp populates D2's CapabilityMatrix, whose value is purely correctness/observability (converts silent Eager/CPU degrade into a logged 'this model cannot be accelerated here' verdict) - wire it via the signature change through apply_execution_providers' Auto arm AND select_perf, with accel_ep_for as the shared join. (4) D3's exports are gated LAST, behind proof the EP path executes at all, and projected with the launch-bound classifier (expect ~0 HBM-bandwidth uplift; the exported backbone loses CUDA-graph + ring-KV). Honest framing for the whole gap: the deliverable is a COVERAGE/observability win (models run at all on the local accelerator + an evidence-gated 'cannot accelerate here' verdict), NOT a GB10 speedup and NOT a today-provable non-CUDA execution - every non-CUDA EP stays UNPROVEN-ON-SILICON until Step 0 lands.

dossiers.current_state:
TWO sub-claims verified against live code; both are further along than the brief implies.

(a) SDPA-pin is arg-steering only — CONFIRMED. kernels/mod.rs:78-94 defines AttnKernel::{Math,MemEfficient,Flash,Cudnn,FusedAuto}; realizes_math() (mod.rs:104) + docs confirm Flash/MemEfficient/Cudnn ALL collapse to the no-mask+is_causal FusedAuto dispatch because tch 0.20 binds only the raw scaled_dot_product_attention op + read-only _fused_sdp_choice probe — no at::globalContext().setSDPPriorityOrder/setSDPUseCudnn FFI. So the 215->11ms cuDNN pin is unreachable via tch today.
BUT pinning ROI is near-zero on every CURRENT model — attention never dominates: dia2 decode attention = 1.5% (brief); voxtral STT decode is LAUNCH-bound — MEASURED perf/path-b/voxtral/baseline_default_graph-on_trt-off_b1: decode = 76.0% of wall (5584.6ms), top kernel = unrolled_elementwise/direct_copy (compute 12% / mem 16% / gpu_busy 0.23 => launch-bound), recommended_lever = "CUDA-graph the step" NOT "pin attention". Encoder attention = 385.9ms dev ~= 5% of the 7789ms device total. By roofline (ridge 433.5 FLOP/byte, B=1 q=1 decode AI ~1-2) these are memory/launch-bound BY PHYSICS; a cuDNN pin cannot move a memory-bound kernel.

(b) Fish graph-capture-safe protocol — ALREADY IMPLEMENTED AND LIVE for the ring-KV STT path. kv_cache.rs:184 append_full_masked_graph scatters q=1 KV via index_copy_(2, cur_index, ..) where cur_index is a DEVICE [1] tensor, then masks via self.positions.ge_tensor(&cur_len) over arange(max_seq) (kv_cache.rs:190) -> returns the WHOLE [1,kvh,max_seq,d] buffer + device-computed [1,1,1,max_seq] finfo.min mask. set_step_device(pos) (kv_cache.rs:162) writes device scalars OUTSIDE capture (fill_, no H2D). This IS Fish: CPU-precomputed max_seq upper-bound -> static worst-case grid captured once -> real seq-len only via on-device ge scalar inside kernel -> NO .item(), no per-length recapture, byte-identical. Voxtral wires it live default-on (voxtral.rs:406 graph_on, :500 decode_step_graph, :573 gated pos+1<=DEC_WINDOW). Covers GQA-native, q_len=1 decode. dia2 graph MEASURED 2.211->1.923 RTF.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY MISSING: (1) graph reads O(max_seq) every step (kv_cache.rs:190 masks over full arange) — no kv-length bucketing (runtime/cuda_graph.rs is edge-only single-B). (2) The PAGED path paged_kv.rs PagedKvTable has ZERO live callers (only lib.rs:55 re-export), no device tensors / no graph-mode append — Fish NOT ported to it (design-vs-wired trap). (3) split-K long-seq decode does not exist. Basis: measured captures + grep + roofline.
dossiers.root_cause: Two distinct causes. (a) tch exposes no SDP-priority FFI, so the three pinned-fused AttnKernel variants are dead intents — but this is largely moot because attention is 1.5-5% of every current model (short seqs, hundreds of tokens, AI~1-2 => memory/launch-bound at ridge 433.5). The place attention traffic DOES dominate is LONG-CONTEXT PREFILL: the manual family (voxtral/ark/cohere, self_attention.rs Kernel::ManualGqa/ManualMha, attention.rs:74/89) materializes the full [b,heads,N,N] score matrix + softmax in HBM = ~N/16× the K/V traffic for the voxtral decoder shape (heads32/kvh8/d128) => at N=375 (30s) ~20× the attention HBM a fused flash kernel would move (scores stay in SRAM). That is the vLLM 215->11ms regime, UNSERVED because (i) no real fused pin and (ii) the manual family is a byte-identity scar (fused rounds differently -> WER/MOS-gated, never silent). (b) Fish is ported to the contiguous per-slot ring but not the paged long-form escape, and the paged table is dead code — because short STT clips never engage paging, so it was built (M5-T3) but never wired.

designs.name: Design A — Real SDP-priority FFI (csrc shim) + WER/MOS-gated fused-flash PREFILL for the manual family (the only place attention traffic dominates)
designs.mechanism: Two parts. (1) THE PIN: add waav_sdp_set_backend(flash,cudnn,mem,math) to csrc/cuda_graph_shim.cpp (same ABI-safe pattern as the CUDAGraph shim, cuda_graph.rs:38 extern block) calling at::globalContext().setSDPUseFlash/setSDPUseCuDNN/setSDPUseMemEfficient/setSDPUseMath (or setSDPPriorityOrder) under the generator mutex like the RNG-offset fns (shim:170). Bind it in kernels/mod.rs so AttnKernel::{Flash,Cudnn} actually pin instead of collapsing to FusedAuto (mod.rs:86-91) — makes the existing PerfPolicy template (mod.rs:238 returning AttnKernel::Flash) real with ZERO model edits. (2) THE WIN: add a WER/MOS-gated PerfPolicy arm that, for the manual family PREFILL only (KernelSig q_len>1, Kernel::ManualGqa/ManualMha in voxtral.rs build_encoder/build_layer), routes through nn::sdpa(...mask=None,is_causal=true,enable_gqa) with the pinned flash/cudnn backend instead of sdpa_manual/sdpa_gqa_manual (attention.rs:74/89). Eliminates the [b,heads,N,N] score+softmax HBM materialization; DECODE (q_len=1, ~6% traffic delta by roofline) stays manual+byte-identical. Selection is per-(device,shape,dtype) via the KernelPolicy seam (mod.rs:149) — policy swap, no model edit.
designs.projected_win: Roofline: for voxtral decoder shape (heads32/kvh8/d128), manual prefill score HBM / KV HBM = 2*heads*N/(kvh*d) = N/16. At N=375 fused cuts attention HBM ~24×; encoder attention grows quadratically from MEASURED 385.9ms/5% at N~150 to ~30% of wall at N~375 and dominant at N>=1500. Net wall: ~0% at today's 12s clips, but 15-40% at long-context STT where the score matrix IS the wall — the only design touching the vLLM 215->11ms regime. Basis: N^2 score-materialization elimination, score tensor = heads*N^2*2B read+written ~4 passes at 198.5 GB/s (perf_equations MBU).
designs.tdd_plan: RED first: (1) sdp_pin_actually_selects_backend — read the _fused_sdp_choice probe (already bound) before/after waav_sdp_set_backend(flash=1) on a shape the heuristic would give mem-efficient; assert it flips (proves the FFI pins). (2) manual_prefill_vs_fused_prefill_wer_gate — the DETERMINISTIC ACCURACY GATE: voxtral transcribe on the 2 LibriSpeech golden clips (~/.cache/waav-models/voxtral-tts-golden) manual vs fused-flash prefill; assert avg WER delta <= the standing 0.15 gate AND WER(fused)<=WER(manual)+eps. NOT byte-identical (fused rounds differently — the scar) so it is a WER gate by construction, behind an explicit WAAV_VOXTRAL_PERF_ATTN flag (never silent). (3) PERF gate: microbench encoder attention HBM at N in {150,375,1500} via nn/profiler.rs CUDA-events; assert fused/manual HBM <= 0.2 at N=375. Decode keeps its byte-identical oracle (voxtral solo_token_ids max|Δ|=0).
designs.coverage: Applies to the 3 manual-family models (voxtral STT, ark STT, cohere AED) — the only models with a materialized-score attention that grows with context. The pin FFI is universal (all 7 torch models, any AttnKernel). Fused-prefill scoped to STT/long-context because fused rounds != reference -> WER-gated, admissible only where WER is the native gate; codec-AR TTS (dia2/csm/cosy) already run fused or Math and have no long prefill. Path-B(tch)/CUDA only; Path-A(ORT) already has flash via GroupQueryAttention. Quant-agnostic (pin is a backend choice, orthogonal to weight quant).
designs.risks_conflicts: BYTE-IDENTITY LAW: fused SDPA != manual sdpa_manual in bf16 (attention.rs:11-21 B27/B23 scar). MITIGATION: strictly WER/MOS-gated, flag-guarded, decode stays manual byte-identical. cfg_batch batch-2 refusal (cfg_batch.rs:177): N/A (STT is B=1, no CFG). Lockstep/ring-KV: untouched (prefill, before ring decode). MaskedCell/ChannelId: untouched. DESIGN-VS-WIRED: wires into the LIVE voxtral encode()/build_encoder path via the already-consulted KernelPolicy seam — makes PerfPolicy non-inert. Risk the flash pin destabilizes graph capture — mitigated because prefill is NOT graphed (runtime/cuda_graph.rs prefill-excluded). Risk cuDNN SDPA unavailable/slower on sm_121 aarch64 -> the pin must probe+fallback like the FlashInfer-forbidden rule.

designs.name: Design B — KV-length bucketed graph cache (LRU) + port the live Fish graph-mode into the paged long-form escape (kill the dead-code trap)
designs.mechanism: The live graph (kv_cache.rs:190) masks over full arange(max_seq) every step -> O(max_seq) HBM per step regardless of real cur_len. (1) BUCKETING: extend runtime/cuda_graph.rs EdgeCaptureKey (currently (B,stride)) with a kv_bucket dim {256,1024,4096,16384}; capture one graph per bucket into an LRU cache (vLLM-Omni stealable: LRU graph cache + eviction); each step picks the smallest bucket>=cur_len and replays that graph, so append_full_masked_graph narrows buffer+mask to bucket not max_seq. Byte-identical: the region [cur_len..bucket] already softmaxes to 0 (kv_cache.rs:191 where_self fill), so a smaller bucket covering cur_len gives identical output — only WHICH capture replays changes. (2) PAGED PORT: give paged_kv.rs PagedKvTable a device-resident twin ([max_pages*page_tokens,hidden] pool + device page-table index tensor) and residency_graph() that gathers resident pages via on-device index_select keyed off a device cur_len — the Fish machinery (set_step_device/append_full_masked_graph) generalized to a gathered page layout. Then WIRE it: a live long-form caller in voxtral.rs transcribe() drops into the paged escape when max_seq>threshold (currently dead re-export lib.rs:55).
designs.projected_win: For a long clip max_seq=16384 avg cur_len~4096, bucketing cuts per-step masked-buffer KV read 4× (16384->4096-bucket), MBU-bound. At voxtral decode=76% of wall and the masked-buffer read being the launch-bound top kernel's memory component, ~10-20% wall cut at long context (bounded because decode is also launch-bound — the graph replay already collapsed launches; this attacks the residual memory). Paged port bounds long-form STT memory to max_pages*page_tokens (L12 escape) so a 30-min transcription doesn't OOM the shared 130.6GB pool. Basis: MBU at 198.5 GB/s, linear in bucket width.
designs.tdd_plan: RED first: (1) bucketed_graph_byte_identical_across_buckets — drive voxtral decode to cur_len=300; assert the 1024-bucket graph and the full-max_seq graph emit max|Δ|=0 token ids (byte-identical is the correct gate — bucketing changes no math). (2) paged_graph_matches_ring_graph — the paged residency_graph gather must be byte-identical to ring append_full_masked_graph for any cur_len in the resident window (extends the existing paged_kv output_identical_within_window test, paged_kv.rs:504, to the DEVICE path). (3) lru_evict_no_recapture_thrash — assert bucket transitions capture at most once per bucket (no per-step recapture, the F7/graph_fallback.rs scar). PERF gate: microbench per-step KV HBM at cur_len 300 with max_seq 16384; assert bucketed HBM <= 1.1× ideal cur_len HBM.
designs.coverage: Bucketing universal to every graph-decode model (the 4 graphable dia2/csm/omnivoice/dots + voxtral ring-graph) — a runtime/cuda_graph.rs policy, no model edit. Paged port scoped to long-form STT/S2S (voxtral, ark, native-S2S) where turn length is unbounded; short TTS never engages it (escape-only, paged_kv.rs:13). CUDA/Path-B; paged bookkeeping is backend-free (P-8) so Path-A can reuse the page-table. Quant-agnostic (KV dtype flows through the graph-driven-dtype seam already proven for q4f16).
designs.risks_conflicts: Recapture thrash if buckets too fine (dots.rs already thrashes on total change) — mitigated by coarse power-of-4 buckets + LRU. Ring-KV invariant: the paged twin must NOT replace the per-slot ring default (paged is escape-only) — enforced by the threshold gate. ChannelId/recycle: the paged table already carries channel_id (paged_kv.rs:203) + stale-channel rejection; the device twin must re-stamp atomically on reset (paged_kv.rs:360). Byte-identity: PRESERVED (bucketing + gather change no math) — the byte-identical companion to Design A. DESIGN-VS-WIRED: explicitly closes the trap — acceptance criterion IS a live transcribe() caller + a serve-loop long-form test. cfg_batch: N/A. Risk: device page-gather (index_select) adds a kernel inside the captured body — must be capture-safe (index device-resident like cur_index) — validated by test (2).

designs.name: Design C — Split-K flash-decode for long-context memory-bound attention (HONESTLY DEFERRED: ROI < 1%)
designs.mechanism: At large kv_len the graph decode's single q-row attention over max_seq is one thread-block reduction => occupancy-starved on GB10's 48 SMs (MEASURED dia2 achieved-occupancy 0.37, perf/path-b/dia2). Split-K partitions kv_len across SMs, each computes a partial softmax (online log-sum-exp), then a combine kernel — raising occupancy toward 0.8. tch cannot express this, so route the decode-attention op EITHER through an ORT CUDA sub-graph (backend-ort ships a split-K-capable GroupQueryAttention/MHA kernel, ep.rs) via a per-op IoBinding seam, OR a hand C++/CUDA kernel in csrc keyed on kv_len>2048. Selection via the KernelPolicy (mod.rs:149) so only long-context decode routes to it.
designs.projected_win: Roofline: occupancy 0.37->~0.8 at long kv_len ~= 2× the attention KERNEL slice. BUT attention is 1.5% of dia2 / ~5% of voxtral => net wall win < 1% on every current model. Only a genuine multi-minute S2S turn at kv_len>8192 makes attention a double-digit slice; even then split-K is bounded by the memory-bound ceiling (AI~1, 198.5 GB/s). HONEST VERDICT: build ONLY if/when a long-form S2S model ships with measured attention >15% of wall. Basis: perf_equations occupancy->throughput + measured dia2 occ 0.37.
designs.tdd_plan: RED first (only when triggered): (1) splitk_decode_wer_gate — split-K reassociates the reduction so it is NOT byte-identical; gate on WER/MOS vs manual decode on the golden set (deterministic WER gate, flag-guarded). (2) splitk_matches_fused_f32 — in f32 the split-K partial-softmax combine must match single-block to <1e-5 (proves the algorithm, not bf16 rounding). PERF gate: ncu occupancy at kv_len 8192 >= 0.7 (proxy lts__t_bytes.sum since GB10 has no dram__* counters). Do NOT wire into the live path until the perf trigger (attention>15%) is measured — record the deferral.
designs.coverage: Scoped HONESTLY to long-context decode (kv_len>~2048) on Path-B; Path-A already has split-K via ORT. Applies to any AR decoder but only matters for long-form S2S/STT. NOT universal — and that is the honest answer: at the sequence lengths every current WaaV model runs, ridge-point physics make attention memory/launch-bound and split-K a <1% lever.
designs.risks_conflicts: Byte-identity: BROKEN (reduction reassociation, same class as cfg_batch.rs:177 BatchAxisReducedInGemm 3.9e-4 flip) => WER/MOS-gated only, never default. Adds a second execution substrate (ORT sub-graph inside a tch decode) — a concurrency/ownership hazard (the ORT+tch deadlock scar from memory) — high complexity for <1% win. DESIGN-VS-WIRED: deliberately NOT wired (deferred); the risk is building unwired machinery — the exact trap paged_kv/admission/stage-DAG already fell into. RECOMMEND NOT BUILDING until a measured trigger exists.

dossiers.recommended: Design A is the primary lever and the only one that touches the vLLM 215->11ms regime honestly: it builds the real SDP-priority FFI (making the dead Flash/Cudnn AttnKernel intents live with zero model edits) AND applies it where attention traffic actually dominates — long-context PREFILL score-matrix elimination for the manual STT family (roofline ~N/16× HBM saving, ~20× at N=375). It is WER-gated (correct, since the manual family is a byte-identity scar). Ship Design B as the byte-identical companion: KV-length bucketing is a pure-win no-math-change graph policy helping every graphable model, and porting the live Fish graph-mode into the paged escape finally WIRES the dead paged_kv.rs (closing the design-vs-wired trap). Explicitly DEFER Design C — split-K decode is <1% net on every current model by ridge-point physics; building it now is the unwired-machinery anti-pattern. The single most important honesty here: part (b) of the gap ("port Fish to WaaV's STT decode") is ALREADY DONE and live (kv_cache.rs:184 + voxtral.rs:500) — the real remaining work is bucketing it (B) and extending it to paged long-form (B), not re-porting it.
dossiers.other_gaps_found: 1. DEAD-CODE / design-vs-wired: paged_kv.rs PagedKvTable (764 lines, fully tested) has ZERO live callers — only lib.rs:55 re-export; same for admission.rs DutyLedger/KvFirewall and dag/stage.rs StageNode. Building tested-but-unwired machinery is a recurring anti-pattern. 2. The masked-full-buffer graph decode (kv_cache.rs:190) reads O(max_seq) HBM every step with no bucketing — a silent quadratic-ish cost at long context no current test catches (all golden clips ~12s). 3. voxtral runs the ENCODER in f32 (voxtral.rs:309, robustness) AND uses ManualGqa — so long-clip encoder attention is f32 manual score materialization, the worst HBM case; Design A's fused-flash prefill is doubly valuable there but must reconcile with the f32-encoder byte-identity decision (fused-f32 still rounds differently than manual-f32 softmax -> WER-gated). 4. runtime EdgeCaptureKey is single-B edge-only with no kv-length axis — adding it (Design B) also unblocks batched-graph bucketing: dia2.rs:1146 currently DISABLES the backbone graph for batched serve rather than bucketing it (a separate ~15% launch win left on the table). 5. AttnKernel::Cudnn is named but the FFI may find cuDNN SDPA unavailable/slower than flash on sm_121 aarch64 — the pin must probe _fused_sdp_choice + fallback (like the FlashInfer-forbidden-on-Blackwell rule), not assume cuDNN.

per_design.design_name: Design A — Real SDP-priority FFI + WER/MOS-gated fused-flash PREFILL for the manual family
per_design.kill_or_flaw_reasons: MECHANISM CORRECTNESS BUG (verified in code): the design routes manual-family PREFILL through nn::sdpa(mask=None, is_causal=true) for KernelSig q_len>1 in BOTH build_encoder and build_layer. But voxtral/ark's encoder is a Whisper-style BIDIRECTIONAL, NON-CAUSAL tower — encode() calls self.encoder.forward(mel) with no causal mask (voxtral.rs:456-458), and cohere's cross-attention is likewise non-causal. Forcing is_causal=true there masks out future mel frames and CORRUPTS THE ENCODING — a catastrophic WER regression, not the sub-ULP bf16 scar the WER gate is scoped for. Only the DECODER prefill is causal. Conflating encoder + decoder prefill under one is_causal=true arm is a real bug, not a rounding difference. SECOND FLAW — the win is near-zero at current workloads by the design's own numbers + measured truth: encoder attention = 385.9ms ~= 5% of the 7789ms device wall; decode = 76% and launch-bound (stays manual).
